title: Non-JSON round responses show an explained message
summary: describeRoundError explains SyntaxError instead of showing parser text
description: Context: describeRoundError in App.tsx handles ApiError, TypeError and generic Error, so a SyntaxError from res.json() falls into the generic Error branch and its message is shown. Desired: SyntaxError returns 'Round service returned an unexpected response (not JSON)'. Why: no raw parser text in the UI.
acceptance_criteria: Given a SyntaxError, When describeRoundError runs, Then it returns 'Round service returned an unexpected response (not JSON)'
Given an ApiError, a TypeError, another Error or a non-Error, When describeRoundError runs, Then the output is unchanged
technical_constraints: SyntaxError check must come before the generic Error branch
